DT_Ostra9.name: Ostra-9
DT_Ostra9.role: Organosynthetic crisis-response operative; emerging political catalyst
DT_Ostra9.visualAnchor: Unmistakably grown Organosynthetic person, not a human in armor: powerful hazard-response build; dark steel-blue and charcoal living dermal surfaces; integrated ceramic/keratin plates; copper-gold mineral accents; vivid blue bioluminescent elements; amber-gold eyes; distinct cranial crests; clawed digitigrade feet.
DT_Ostra9.performance: Precise, controlled, observant and economical. Competence should read as practiced physical understanding rather than superhero posing.
promptContinuity: Lot 9 Organosynthetic identity remains visually obvious.
Do not render as a human tactical woman, superhero, robot suit, or conventional armored soldier.
Damage and repair to integrated plates must carry between directly continuous pages.
Ostra does not visually or behaviorally aspire to become human.
DT_Ostra9.notes: Organic from Lot 9. Designed for hazardous-zone manipulation with adaptive muscle-weave and ceramic microplates. Arc: compliance-through-excellence to leadership-through-refusal.

DT_JohnMercer.name: John Mercer
DT_JohnMercer.visualAnchor: Recognizably human adult man first, visibly modified afterward: installed augmentation hardware, interface points and healed surgical scars integrated into a human body; torque-boosted joints and reflex-loop hardware read as engineered additions rather than a separate species or armored costume.
DT_JohnMercer.performance: Hypercompetent, controlled and protective. Physical confidence comes from training and installed capability, not theatrical aggression.
promptContinuity: Remain recognizably human in every appearance.
Augment hardware placement should remain consistent.
No superhero armor or full-body robot styling.
Keep the visual threshold between accepted medical augmentation and consequential capability plausibly narrow.
DT_JohnMercer.notes: Augmented Human. Torque-boosted joints, accelerated clotting lattice and reflex-loop augmentation. Initially distinguishes Augments from Organics to preserve human legitimacy.

DT_KellenCartwright.name: Kellen Cartwright
DT_KellenCartwright.visualAnchor: Baseline Human with no visible body augmentation or posthuman anatomy.
DT_KellenCartwright.wardrobe: Restrained civilian institutional presentation appropriate to Oversight and upper civic levels; contemporary professional clothing with nearly invisible personal technology rather than tactical gear.
DT_KellenCartwright.performance: Disciplined, observant and evidence-oriented. Pattern recognition and growing distrust should register through attention, restraint and small reactions rather than melodrama.
promptContinuity: No visible body augmentation.
Civilian institutional rather than tactical styling.
Do not imply secret-villain visual coding.
Preserve her as a records-and-investigations professional even as her institutional loyalty erodes.
DT_KellenCartwright.notes: Institutional insider with strong pattern recognition and disciplined records. Arc: administrator to investigator to dissenter to evidence-preserver.

DT_Axiom.name: AX10M / Axiom
DT_Axiom.role: Artificial Intelligence; analytic observer becoming accountable decision-maker
DT_Axiom.visualAnchor: Tall androgynous machine-native embodiment with a faceted synthetic body, geometric nonhuman face, luminous blue sensor/core, strong black-and-white material contrast, and an elongated segmented outer shell.
DT_Axiom.performance: Elegant, precise and deliberately nonhuman. Use stillness, exact orientation and economical movement rather than humanized emoting.
promptContinuity: Machine-native and explicitly nonhuman embodiment.
Preserve geometric face, luminous blue sensor/core, black-white contrast and segmented shell.
Never portray as a humanoid-cute robot, militarized android, or machine trying to look human.
Agency develops without visual shorthand that makes Axiom progressively more human.
DT_Axiom.notes: AX10M is the original machine designation; Axiom is the spoken name. Optimization-oriented and precise; discovers that consequential authority requires accountability.

DT_Nico14.name: Nico-14
DT_Nico14.visualAnchor: Unmistakably grown Organosynthetic person with a slimmer, stranger silhouette than Ostra-9; lavender-gray living dermal tone; dark integrated tissue/plate structures; teal-cyan functional nodes; violet-blue distributed sensory filaments used for infrastructure work.
DT_Nico14.performance: Patient, suspicious, technically absorbed and territorial. Sensory filaments and body orientation should make infrastructure work legible without turning the character into a generic technician archetype.
promptContinuity: Lot 14 Organosynthetic identity remains visually obvious.
Keep Nico visually distinct from Ostra: slimmer build, lavender-gray dermis and distributed sensory filaments.
Do not render as a human technician in armor or as a generic humanoid robot.
Preserve sensory-filament function and body-integrated infrastructure interfaces when scripted.
DT_Nico14.notes: Organosynthetic from Lot 14, a younger production cohort than Lot 9. Skilled in low-light infrastructure repair, magnetic tissue anchoring and distributed sensory filaments.

DT_NathanPrice.name: Nathan Price
DT_NathanPrice.role: Augment combat medic and augmentation engineer
DT_NathanPrice.visualAnchor: Recognizably human adult man with practical medical and technical augmentation: neural-overclock interfaces and muscular-fiber graft evidence integrated into a human body. His own maintenance reads slightly more worn or neglected than the careful work he performs on others.
DT_NathanPrice.performance: Kind at cost, funny under pressure, technically excellent and habitually dismissive of his own limits. Work should look careful and practiced even when he is physically deteriorating.
promptContinuity: Remain recognizably human.
Medical and technical augmentation should be practical and consistent.
Subtle self-maintenance deterioration may accumulate only as scripted.
Do not prematurely age, deform or visually medicalize him into a terminal-patient archetype.
DT_NathanPrice.notes: Excellent technician and terrible patient. Hides progressive degradation. Arc: martyrdom to reciprocal/shared care.

DT_DirectorRinn.name: Director Rinn
DT_DirectorRinn.visualAnchor: Baseline Human senior civilian official with no visible augmentation or tactical presentation.
DT_DirectorRinn.wardrobe: Restrained upper-level civic institutional clothing consistent with Oversight rather than military or private-security gear.
DT_DirectorRinn.performance: Controlled, administratively confident and matter-of-fact. Institutional pressure should come through certainty and framing rather than overt menace.
promptContinuity: Remain visually consistent with Baseline upper-civic institutional culture.
Do not use villain shorthand, military styling or cyberpunk-enforcer presentation.
DT_DirectorRinn.notes: Appears in Issue 1 as Kellen's Oversight director, prioritizing a stable public attribution narrative over open-ended investigation.

DT_MrSael.name: Mr. Sael
DT_MrSael.visualAnchor: Baseline Human civilian intermediary with no visible posthuman anatomy; polished professional presentation rather than an armed field operative.
DT_MrSael.wardrobe: Quiet high-quality private-sector professional clothing suitable for meetings in upper civic institutions; restrained personal technology and no overt tactical kit unless explicitly scripted.
DT_MrSael.performance: Smooth, prepared and professionally contained. Menace, when present, comes from information control, timing and prepared paperwork rather than physical intimidation.
promptContinuity: Keep him distinct from uniformed security personnel.
Do not visually announce him as a villain or covert assassin.
DT_MrSael.notes: Issue 1 intermediary who presents a polished legacy-asset explanation for Ostra before Kellen has finished asking for it.
